text.steps: 1. ESD02-004 invades. 2. Pay its cost by discarding Destoroyah Perfect Form (rank 8) from your hand.
text.result: Destroys every opponent battle card of rank 8 or lower, which is every battle card in the starters
text.success: ESD02-004's cost is paid with a rank 8 card and at least 1 card is destroyed

text.steps: 1. Both Larvae are in your discard pile. 2. ESD02-003 enters: play both Larvae from the discard pile into zones adjacent to it. 3. At your next main phase, evolve them into Mothra (Imago) and Battra (Imago). Mothra (Imago) draws 1.
text.result: Two battle cards back from the discard pile, then a rank 5 and a rank 6 battle card plus a draw
text.success: ESD02-003 plays both Larvae, and at least 1 of them evolves by the end of your next main phase. Spans two turns

text.cards: The Legend of Infant Island (ESD02-014), Mothra (Larva) (ESD02-007), Mothra (Imago) (ESD02-010)
text.steps: 1. Mothra (Larva) is on the board. 2. Activate The Legend of Infant Island: evolve it now, without waiting for the start of your main phase. 3. Mothra (Imago) enters through evolution and draws 1.
text.result: Instant rank 5 battle card plus a card
text.success: The Legend of Infant Island evolves Mothra (Larva) and Mothra (Imago)'s draw resolves

text.steps: 1. With your monster in zone 4 or beyond, play Super-X in zone 8: the opponent loses 1 rage. 2. ESD02-005 invades 2 zones: the opponent loses 1 rage per zone.
text.result: The opponent loses up to 3 rage in one turn, which shuts off the red deck's 2-or-more rage effects
text.success: In one turn, Super-X and ESD02-005 together take at least 2 rage from the opponent
